businesses.business: infection prevention and sterilization products and services

offering_description.value: Provides infection prevention, sterile processing and surgical products and services to hospitals, surgical centers, pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers. Makes capital equipment, consumables and sterilization systems, and delivers contract sterilization and reprocessing services.

primary_products.value: sterilizers and washers; surgical tables, lights and equipment management systems; endoscopy accessories and consumables; infection prevention consumables and detergents; dental products

primary_services.value: equipment maintenance and repair; contract sterilization (gamma, e-beam, EO); instrument reprocessing and repair; lab testing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, surgical centers, dental practices, pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers, research labs; B2G: government-run hospitals and military/public health facilities

end_markets.value: healthcare; life sciences; pharmaceutical manufacturing; medical device manufacturing; dental

revenue_model.value: product sales: capital equipment and recurring consumables sold to healthcare and life sciences customers; service fees: maintenance, repair, reprocessing and per-load contract sterilization; project or contract: equipment installation and facility build-out projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures sterilizers, surgical equipment and consumables from purchased components, sold to hospitals and manufacturers; service provider: operates contract sterilization facilities and field service for medical device makers and healthcare providers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, with large US presence

specialization.value: related lines: healthcare, life sciences, dental and contract sterilization lines sharing infection prevention focus and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and service teams selling to hospitals and manufacturers; distributors / dealers: dental and consumables distributors; own locations: contract sterilization and reprocessing facilities
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and sterilants requiring FDA clearance and EPA registration, sterilization facilities under EPA, OSHA and ISO rules
